---
title: "Sessions by Age Group"
date: "19-10-2026"
output: html_document
---

This report analyzes how frequently users of different age groups engage with the platform, measured by **average sessions per player**.

```{r}
# Load the dataset
sessions_age <- read.csv("session_regarding_age.csv")

# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)

# Convert any necessary columns to numeric
sessions_age$avg_sessions_per_player <- as.numeric(sessions_age$avg_sessions_per_player)

# Plot average sessions per player by age group
ggplot(sessions_age, aes(x = age_group, y = avg_sessions_per_player)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "skyblue", color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(avg_sessions_per_player, 2)), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Sessions per Player by Age Group",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Average Sessions per Player"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
